ghetto concept.bio: Toronto hip-hop duo Ghetto Concept, formed by Kwajo Cinqo and Dolo, helped establish the city's independent rap scene in the 1990s and won consecutive Juno Awards for early singles.

gob.bio: Langley, British Columbia punk band Gob is a long-running Canadian pop-punk and alternative-rock group known for melodic hooks, energetic live shows and a catalogue dating to the 1990s.

grandtheft.bio: Toronto producer and DJ Grandtheft, born Aaron Waisglass, makes bass-heavy electronic music spanning trap, house, hip-hop and dancehall-informed club production.

harrison.bio: Toronto electronic producer Harrison Robinson makes melodic, jazz- and R&B-informed electronic music and has become a distinctive voice in Canada's beat and dance-music scenes.

hawksley workman.bio: Huntsville-born multi-instrumentalist Hawksley Workman is a Juno-winning Canadian singer-songwriter whose prolific catalogue moves between cabaret pop, glam rock and indie rock.

headstones.bio: Kingston, Ontario band Headstones is a veteran Canadian hard-rock and punk-rock group fronted by Hugh Dillon and known for an intense, stripped-down live sound.

hollerado.bio: Ottawa indie-rock band Hollerado combines power-pop hooks, wiry guitars and high-energy performances in a distinctly Canadian catalogue that began in the late 2000s.

holly mcnarland.bio: Winnipeg-born Métis singer-songwriter Holly McNarland is a Canadian alternative-rock artist whose powerful vocals and emotionally direct writing broke through nationally in the 1990s.

i mother earth.bio: Toronto band I Mother Earth is a Canadian alternative-rock group known for combining hard rock with funk, progressive-rock and fusion influences.

in essence.bio: Toronto R&B group In Essence brought polished harmonies and contemporary soul to Canadian radio in the early 2000s, winning a Juno Award for the album The Master Plan.

infinite.bio: Toronto rapper Infinite, born Desmond Francis, emerged from Rexdale and Ghetto Concept before building a solo career rooted in Canadian underground hip-hop.

jacksoul.bio: Toronto soul and R&B group jacksoul, led by singer-songwriter Haydain Neale, earned multiple Juno Awards for emotionally direct songwriting and polished, groove-driven recordings.

jacques greene.bio: Montréal-born Canadian producer Jacques Greene, the project of Philippe Aubin-Dionne, makes emotionally rich electronic music shaped by house, R&B and club culture.

jahkoy.bio: Toronto-born singer, rapper and songwriter Jahkoy Palmer blends contemporary R&B, pop and hip-hop in a melodic catalogue shaped by both Canadian and international influences.

jazz cartier.bio: Toronto-born rapper Jazz Cartier, born Jahmarie Adams, is known for theatrical, bass-heavy hip-hop and projects that earned Polaris Music Prize recognition and a Juno Award.

jd era.bio: Mississauga-raised rapper JD Era is a Canadian lyricist known for technically sharp hip-hop, freestyle work and collaborations across Toronto's rap scene.

jeremy dutcher.bio: Wolastoqiyik tenor, composer and performer Jeremy Dutcher of Neqotkuk in New Brunswick brings classical training together with Wolastoqey language and archival recordings in award-winning contemporary work.
